title: With nothing ticked Activate is disabled and its hover text says why
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ACTNONE-01) is inactive at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Activate parts.
  6. Hover over the Activate button on the bar.
  7. Click the Activate button.
  8. Click the {Part-A} row.
  9. Hover over the Activate button.
  10. Click the X at the right end of the bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The Activate button is visible but dimmed (disabled), and hovering it shows "Tick the parts to activate".
  • Step 7: Nothing opens: no "Activate parts?" confirmation appears.
  • Step 9: With 1 row ticked the button is bright blue (enabled) and the hover text does not appear.
  • Step 10: Bulk mode ends and {Part-A} is still inactive.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S3-N1, S3-R3, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N1: “With nothing ticked, the Activate button is visible but disabled.”
  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Activate hovered with nothing ticked): “"Tick the parts to activate" | Tooltip on the disabled button”
